retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast pop art style featuring halftone-patterned portraits layered over vibrant color blocks with hand-drawn gestural accents.

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition combining high-contrast halftone portraits of a group with bold, flat color fields and expressive, black ink-stroke squiggles. The portraits use a coarse dot pattern to define shadows against white highlights, creating a graphic, printed feel.
coreVisualRelationships: Halftone portraits layered over a solid cyan background
A diagonal red banner containing primary display text
Black organic ink strokes floating as decorative accents
A black curved corner element for secondary metadata
coreInvariants: Coarse halftone dot pattern used for all photographic shadows
Primary color palette of cyan, red, black, and white
Sharp, non-blended edges between color blocks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five figures arranged in a tiered group portrait occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red diagonal banner in the lower right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the faces at the top, down the diagonal of the red banner, to the black corner text at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid cyan sky-like area at the top provides breathing room for the busy halftone textures.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primary colors contrasted against stark black and white halftone textures.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
characterSpecificRedesigns: Italicized 'A' in the main title for dynamic movement
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mixing upright bold serifs for names with slanted/italicized serifs for titles.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the main title.
Appropriate for the secondary metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage with five figures in a coarse black-and-white halftone style. Place them against a solid cyan background. Add a large diagonal red banner across the bottom right and a black curved shape in the bottom left. Include loose, black ink-stroke squiggles in the empty cyan areas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the main title in a bold, high-contrast white serif font, angled to match the red banner. Add secondary track listing in a smaller white serif font within the black corner shape.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern coarse and visible?
Is the red banner angled diagonally?
Are the ink squiggles present and organic?
Is the text high-contrast white serif?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the collage
mustRedesign: Do not replicate specific song titles or band names
postGenerationChecks: Check that halftone dots do not blur into solid gray.
Ensure the red banner has a hand-cut collage edge feel.
Verify the ink squiggles look hand-drawn, not computer-generated.
Confirm the serif typography has high stroke contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Halftone Portraits + Primary Color Blocks + High-Contrast Serif Typography + Gestural Ink Accents
